"Recently updated" works — editing Banana's note jumped it to the top. Here's the quick confirmation.

---

### 🔗 http://maker:4001 (refresh)

Save a few links, then set **Sort → Recently updated**.

**Action — Freshly touched links rise**
1. Pick an *older* link and **Edit** it — change its note or title and Save.
2. That link immediately jumps to the **top** of the "Recently updated" order, so what you just worked on is right where you'll look.

---

One small thing to confirm: I treat a link as "updated" whenever its content changes — **editing** it, and also **marking it read/unread or archiving/restoring** it. That way "Recently updated" reflects any recent activity on a link, not just note edits. If you'd rather it track *only* edits to the title/description/note (and ignore status changes), tell me and I'll narrow it.

With **Recently updated** added to Newest / Oldest / Title A–Z / Title Z–A, does the sorting fully match what you want?
